title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE BADUK PROMOTION ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE BADUK PROMOTION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated under the Baduk Promotion Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Competitions for Verification of Baduk Playing Skills)
The term "competition for verification of Baduk playing skills prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Baduk Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means a competition hosted for the selection of professional Baduk players by a nonprofit corporation that performs duties relating to the dissemination, education and international exchange of Baduk and is designated and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. The defined term also includes a method of selecting professional Baduk players whereby that nonprofit corporation recognizes persons as having Baduk playing skills equivalent to those of professional Baduk players, taking into account their record of activities in international Baduk competitions and other relevant performance.

Article 3 (Formulation of the Master Plan for Baduk Promotion)
(1) The term "matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 5 (2) 11 of the Act means the following:
1. Matters concerning the discovery, collection and preservation of materials relating to Baduk;
2. Matters concerning the development and dissemination of content for the promotion of Baduk.
(2) Where the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism formulates the master plan for Baduk promotion under Article 5 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the Mayor of the Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City Mayors, the Mayor of the Special Self-Governing City, Do Governors, the Governor of the Special Self-Governing Province, and the heads of Si, Gun and Gu (referring to the heads of self-governing Gu) thereof.

Article 4 (Baduk Day)
(1) The State, local governments, Baduk organizations and other relevant bodies may hold any of the following events on Baduk Day under Article 7 (1) of the Act:
1. Baduk competitions (including demonstration matches);
2. Academic events relating to Baduk;
3. Awards to persons of merit in Baduk;
4. Events concerning the development of Baduk-related technologies;
5. Other events concerning the dissemination and promotion of Baduk.
(2) The State and local governments may provide necessary support to Baduk organizations, etc. holding events under paragraph (1).

Article 5 (Entrustment or Agency Performance of Projects Supporting International Exchange and Overseas Dissemination)
The term "relevant institutions or organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 13 (2) of the Act means institutions or organizations that conduct duties relating to the dissemination, education and international exchange of Baduk and are designated and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 29226, Oct. 16, 2018>

This Decree shall enter into force on October 18, 2018.
